segments.t: At the ASK anniversary party, Andrea and Gabriel face furious questions about Isabelle Huppert's secret schedule. To defuse the accusations, Andrea and Gabriel explain that director Cedric Kahn hired an artistic double to create a poetic ghost. Let's listen to their conversation in French first.
Les producteurs américains posent des questions.
Ils pensent qu'Isabelle a triché?
Ils ont vu le tournage nocturne.
Isabelle était au mariage de son fils!
Il s'agit d'un énorme malentendu.
Cédric Kahn a utilisé un double.
Une doublure pour créer un fantôme.
C'est une idée poétique et surréaliste!
En France, nous avons des idées.
Les Américains veulent voir les images.
Le premier montage est dans le bureau.
Allons leur montrer ce beau film.
Espérons que le résultat soit convaincant.
Notre agence sauvera ce projet important.
Let's examine the conversation line by line and explore the French expressions.
Les producteurs américains posent des questions.
'The American producers are asking questions.' Gabriel warns of incoming scrutiny. The verbal locution 'ask' means to ask questions.
Ils pensent qu'Isabelle a triché?
'Do they think that Isabelle cheated?' Andrea inquires about the gravity of the doubts. The verb 'cheated' means to cheat or play unfairly.
Ils ont vu le tournage nocturne.
'They saw the night shoot.' Gabriel explains that the concurrent production was witnessed. The adjective 'nighttime' describes nighttime activity.
Isabelle était au mariage de son fils!
'Isabelle was at her son's wedding!' Andrea points to the confirmed family event. The noun 'wedding' denotes a wedding celebration.
Il s'agit d'un énorme malentendu.
'This is a huge misunderstanding.' Gabriel emphasizes that everything is innocent. The idiom 'il s'agit de' means it is a matter of.
Cédric Kahn a utilisé un double.
'Cedric Kahn used a double.' Andrea presents their primary narrative defense. The noun 'double' refers to a body double or stand-in.
Une doublure pour créer un fantôme.
'A stand-in to create a ghost.' Gabriel explains the directorial motive. The noun 'stand-in' refers specifically to a stand-in performer.
C'est une idée poétique et surréaliste!
'It is a poetic, surrealist idea!' Andrea sells the artistic rationale with passion. The coordinated adjectives celebrate avant-garde cinema.
En France, nous avons des idées.
'In France, we have ideas.' Gabriel quotes a famous French aphorism. The plural noun 'ideas' conveys ingenuity and creative resourcefulness.
Les Américains veulent voir les images.
'The Americans want to see footage.' Andrea states the demands of the foreign partners. The modal verb 'want' expresses their firm insistence.
Le premier montage est dans le bureau.
'The first cut is in the office.' Gabriel points toward the projection room. The noun 'cut' designates film editing or an edit cut.
Allons leur montrer ce beau film.
'Let us go show them this fine film.' Andrea leads the delegation forward boldly. The imperative 'let us go' expresses collective resolution.
Espérons que le résultat soit convaincant.
'Let us hope the result is convincing.' Gabriel tempers enthusiasm with realism. The subjunctive 'is' follows the verb of hoping or wishing.
Notre agence sauvera ce projet important.

'Our agency will save this important project.' Andrea rallies her fellow agent. The future verb 'will save' promises a successful rescue. Now let's listen to the complete discussion once more to reinforce the vocabulary.
